import Ps.Syntax.Lexer

def psCompilerServiceCandidate (source : String) : String :=
  match psLex source with
  | Except.ok tokens => psNatToString (psLexListLength tokens)
  | Except.error error =>
      match error with
      | PsLexError.unterminatedBlockComment span =>
          String.Internal.append "block:" (psNatToString span.stop.byteOffset)
      | PsLexError.unterminatedString span =>
          String.Internal.append "string:" (psNatToString span.stop.byteOffset)
      | PsLexError.newlineInString span =>
          String.Internal.append "newline:" (psNatToString span.stop.byteOffset)
      | PsLexError.unterminatedCharacter span =>
          String.Internal.append "character:" (psNatToString span.stop.byteOffset)
      | PsLexError.fuelExhausted => "fuel"
      | PsLexError.invalidSource _ span =>
          String.Internal.append "invalid:" (psNatToString span.stop.byteOffset)
